name: Ring of Misfire
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a marksman’s ring. Instead of granting a bonus, the ring imparts a -2 penalty to the wearer’s attack and damage rolls for all ranged attacks.

Casting remove curse and true strike upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items marksman’s ring

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
